content: Individuals with obesity, a family history of diabetes, high-risk ethnic backgrounds, or a history of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) should undergo screening for undiagnosed diabetes or prediabetes prior to conception. This proactive approach aims to reduce the risk of potential complications during pregnancy. At the first prenatal visit, women who present with risk factors should undergo diagnostic testing for diabetes. This is essential to identify any previously undiagnosed cases of diabetes at an early stage.
